title: Quick Watermelon Granita
changes_from_base: Frozen watermelon chunks blended with a little sugar replace the strawberry purée; no syrup or water.
summary: A refreshing frozen treat made by blending watermelon with sugar and lemon before freezing into icy crystals.

ingredients.item: watermelon flesh (rind removed), cut in small chunks

steps.title: Prep fruit
steps.text: Remove the rind and cut 450 g watermelon flesh into small chunks. Spread the chunks on a tray lined with baking paper.

steps.title: Initial freeze
steps.text: Place the tray in the freezer for about 2 h until the fruit is solid.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Put the frozen chunks into a blender with 25 g caster sugar and 2 tbsp lemon juice. Process the mixture until it becomes liquid.

steps.title: Second freeze
steps.text: Pour the liquid into a shallow glass or ceramic dish and return it to the freezer for about 2 h.

steps.title: Scrape
steps.text: Use a fork to break up the ice crystals every 30 min during the freezing process.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Continue until the texture is slushy and crunchy. Spoon the granita into chilled glasses to enjoy immediately.

tips: Use a very ripe melon for the best natural flavour.
Chill the serving glasses beforehand to keep the ice from melting too quickly.
Adjust the lemon juice to balance the sweetness of the fruit.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week and use a fork or soften before serving.
